channel.title: Asad Razzaq, PhD: robots, swarms and AI, explained
channel.description: Articles on swarm intelligence, evolutionary robotics and machine learning, each with an interactive simulation.

item.title: How ants find food without a leader
item.description: No ant knows the map, yet the colony finds short paths to food. Play with a live simulation of pheromone trails, stigmergy and ant colony optimization.

item.title: Picking a playing XI for robots: how many scouts does a swarm need?
item.description: A cricket captain changes the XI for the pitch. Robot swarms need the same thinking: try a simulation to find the best mix of scout and carrier robots.

item.title: Watch a genetic algorithm teach robots to drive
item.description: A genetic algorithm explained with 40 little robots. Watch neural network controllers improve generation by generation, then try the trap course that defeats them.

item.title: Can robots smell? How a robot tracks a gas leak to its source
item.description: Wind tears smells into patches, so following the gradient fails. See how a moth-inspired surge-and-cast strategy finds an odour source anyway.

item.title: Knowledge distillation, explained with robots
item.description: What is knowledge distillation? A plain-English explanation with a live neural network that learns to copy three teachers, and why robot swarms need it.

item.title: Doing a PhD in Japan from Pakistan: a practical guide
item.description: A practical guide for Pakistani students planning a PhD in Japan: finding a supervisor, MEXT, starting as a research student, SPRING changes and a checklist.
